title: Hydraulic Oil Overtemperature
description: Hydraulic oil temperature P051 = {val} °C, above advisory limit (55 °C). Flow rate P052 = {val2} L/min. Seal degradation accelerates above 60 °C.
probable_cause: Oil cooler fouling, high duty cycle, or low oil level reducing heat dissipation.
remedy: Clean oil cooler. Top up oil. Allow temperature to drop before resuming full cycle rate.
required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.
